title: 第20章 大王别笑二王
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
少年剑眉星目，身姿挺拔如青松，周身萦绕着一层淡淡的清气。

    看顾念念的眼底带着自然的欢喜和亲近。

    “小师叔！”

    顾念念张了张嘴，一时间竟被少年的惊天美貌给迷惑了。

    “好漂亮。”

    少年抿嘴笑。

    “小师叔也很可爱。”

    洛靳失笑。

    “好了好了，快收起你的神通吧，你小师叔还小，可别带坏了她。”

    少年轻笑一声，眨眼间气势清润疏离，哪里还有刚刚半分魅惑的模样。

    但，他看顾念念的眼神一点没变。

    顾念念眨巴着眼睛，疑惑的打量着少年。

    她也不知道刚刚是怎么了，只觉得满心满眼都是眼前的这个少年。

    现在她依然觉得少年很漂亮，她很喜欢，可这个喜欢却跟刚刚明显不同，至少她眼底清明一片。

    洛靳见她脸上满是不解，笑容更深。

    “他是我的徒弟，星元！天生魅惑体。”

    顾念念张大了嘴。

    星元半点不在意。

    “是不是觉得魅惑体怎么会出现在一个男人的身上？”

    顾念念傻傻地点头。

    这么实诚，星元乐不可支。

    “当然是师侄我天生丽质，连天道都不忍我的美貌落空，硬生生给了我一个魅惑体。”

    顾念念被他唬得一愣一愣的，眼底都要冒星光了。

    不是因为他的美貌，而是因为他得天道喜欢。

    现在，任何得戴天道眷顾的人，都会被顾念念羡慕。

    洛靳看着星元耍宝，无论多少次，他都觉得丢人。

    实在是想不通，为何师尊要他一个修无情道的人去收一个性格跳脱，还是魅惑体的徒弟。

    洛靳无奈扶额。

    “小师妹，十日后的天渊秘境，星元会跟你一起去，到时候你们两个自成一队，别跟其他人组队，自己宗门的人也不行。”

    顾念念问：“为什么？”

    洛靳很不想说，但一看星元嘚瑟的样子，实在是忍不了。

    “因为没人能顶得住他的魅惑体，除了你。”

    顾念念抬手指了指自己的小鼻头。

    “可我刚刚也被他魅惑了啊。”

    星元大笑：“师尊，小师叔好可爱啊，从秘境回来，我可以申请跟小师叔在一起吗？”

    洛靳一个大比兜直接砸在了他的后脑勺，星元被打得一个踉跄，却还在笑。
content_en:
The young man has sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes, his body is as tall and straight as a green pine, and there is a layer of light freshness lingering around him.

    There was natural joy and intimacy in Gu Niannian's eyes.

    "Little uncle!"

    Gu Niannian opened her mouth, and for a moment she was bewildered by the young man's stunning beauty.

    "So beautiful."

    The young man pursed his lips and smiled.

    "Little uncle is also very cute."

    Luo Jin laughed.

    "Okay, okay, put away your magical powers. Your junior uncle is still young, so don't lead her astray."

    The young man chuckled, and in the blink of an eye his aura was clear and distant, and he still looked half charming.

    However, the way he looked at Gu Niannian didn't change at all.

    Gu Niannian blinked and looked at the young man doubtfully.

    She didn't know what happened just now, she just felt that her heart and eyes were filled with the young man in front of her.

    Now she still thinks the boy is beautiful and she likes him very much, but this liking is obviously different from before. At least her eyes are clear.

    Seeing her face full of confusion, Luo Jin smiled even deeper.

    "He is my apprentice, Xingyuan! He is born with a charm."

    Gu Niannian opened her mouth wide.

    Xingyuan didn't care at all.

    "Do you wonder how the charmed body can appear on a man's body?"

    Gu Niannian nodded stupidly.

    Xingyuan was so happy that he was so sincere.

    "Of course it's my nephew. I'm naturally beautiful. Even Heaven couldn't bear to see my beauty fail, so he gave me a charmed body."

    Gu Niannian was so stunned by him that her eyes almost started to shine.

    Not because of his beauty, but because he is liked by Heaven.

    Now, anyone who is favored by Heaven will be envied by Gu Niannian.

    No matter how many times Luo Jin watched Xing Yuan play tricks, he felt embarrassed.

    I really can't figure out why the master wants him, a person who cultivates the ruthless path, to accept a disciple with an out-of-character personality and a charming body.

    Luo Jin helplessly held his forehead.

    "Little Junior Sister, Xingyuan will go with you to the Tianyuan Secret Realm in ten days. Then you two will form your own team. Don't team up with others, not even people from your own sect."

    Gu Niannian asked: "Why?"

    Luo Jin didn't want to say it, but when he saw Xingyuan's fussy look, he couldn't bear it.

    "Because no one can withstand his charming body, except you."

    Gu Niannian raised her finger and pointed at her little nose.

    "But I was also charmed by him just now."

    Xingyuan laughed: "Master, my little uncle is so cute. When I come back from the secret realm, can I apply to be with my little uncle?"

    Luo Jin hit him directly on the back of the head with a big bag. Xingyuan was hit and staggered, but he was still laughing.
title_en: Chapter 20 King, don’t laugh at the two kings
